blurb: Guests can visit the brewery to enjoy a variety of locally sourced craft beers on tap, including styles like Porter, Pilsner, Märzen, Cream Ale, IPA, Hefeweizen, Kölsch, and Bock. They also offer flavored pretzels in sealed pint containers. The brewery is located beside the Colorado River in Bastrop, Texas.
